requirement:
Create a small Go module using only the standard library. Use exactly this go.mod:
module example.com/task

go 1.22

Put the implementation in `lib/fizzbuzz.go` (package `lib`) and your own tests in `lib/fizzbuzz_test.go` (package `lib`, `go test`). No third-party modules.

SPEC: Implement `func FizzBuzz(n int) []string`. Return the numbers 1..n as strings, replacing multiples of 3 with "Fizz", multiples of 5 with "Buzz" and multiples of both with "FizzBuzz". n <= 0 returns an empty (non-nil) slice.
acceptance_criteria: func FizzBuzz(n int) []string: Return the numbers 1..n as strings, replacing multiples of 3 with "Fizz", multiples of 5 with "Buzz" and multiples of both with "FizzBuzz". n <= 0 returns an empty (non-nil) slice.
